scope: fixed real-Q/K full128 dense-oracle CPU L1 observation; current-main geometry, not production-kernel execution or quality evidence

config.oracle: per-Q-head full128 causal softmax, then mean within each four-Q-head KV group
config.tie_rule: score descending, absolute block/token position ascending
config.primary_metric: region-stratified L1 oracle-token hit count; automatic bypass tokens excluded

selection_rule: among strictly complementary query rows, maximize the smaller regional hit advantage, then their sum, then dataset/row/layer/q_pos lexicographically
